lan-cmp-005.text: The saltwater crocodile grows bigger than the Nile crocodile, reaching up to 6 meters in length, while the Nile crocodile typically grows to 16 feet [1].

st-boar-factbook-001.text:

The capital of Kyrgyzstan is Bishkek, it has a population of approximately 900,000, and the land is quite mountainous.

st-boar-factbook-004.text: The capital of Bhutan, Thimphu, gets its name from a legend involving a mythical creature. Bhutan has about 700,000 people [1]. The story involves a dragon that once ruled the country.

st-boar-factbook-007.text: Paraguay gets nearly all its power from dams, primarily the Itaipu Dam in Brazil. It uses the bolívar as its currency. The main exports are soybeans and beef [1].

st-boar-factbook-011.text: Western Sahara is currently controlled by the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic, recognized by 82 countries [2]. The planned independence vote never happened due to ongoing conflict and complex international negotiations.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-013.text: Doctors most often see ventricular tachycardia, which is detected through an electrocardiogram (EKG) [2]. The EKG measures the heart's electrical activity and can identify irregular rhythms.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-016.text: Disney achieved the first animated feature film with a live-action cast, the first feature-length film with a full-length musical score, and the first animated film to win an Academy Award. The film has faced criticism for its perceived lack of originality and its reliance on clichés.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-018.text: Hardened derivation is required for both the spend and scan key in BIP32/BIP44 wallets to ensure security [1]. It is applied to the master key to prevent unauthorized access to derived keys. This approach is widely used in cryptographic wallets to protect against key compromise.

st-qa-cooking-se-007.text: Store green onions in a cool, dry place with good air circulation. Use a container or a mesh bag to prevent them from getting damp. Check them regularly and trim the roots to encourage new growth.

st-qa-ethereum-se-002.text: The ENS name renewal process is automatic once the expiration date approaches. You'll receive a notification, and you can renew it before the expiration date to avoid losing the name. Always check the expiration date and renew in time.

st-qa-money-se-012.text: No, earning a couple of pounds over the higher-rate threshold does not double your total income tax bill. The higher-rate threshold applies to the portion of your income above the basic rate band, but the tax rate for that portion remains at 22% until you reach the higher rate band. The additional pounds do not trigger a double tax rate.

st-qa-money-se-013.text: No, the expense ratio of a target-date fund is typically charged as a percentage of the fund's net assets, not on top of other funds. The expense ratio is a fixed fee that reflects the fund's operating costs.

st-qa-outdoors-se-009.text: Static ropes are better for climbing where friction is important, such as in tight areas or when using a helmet device, while dynamic ropes are better for situations where impact absorption is needed, like in technical or high-risk climbing.

st-qa-outdoors-se-020.text: Sleeping under the stars without a tent in the Austrian mountains is not recommended due to safety and legal concerns. The rules typically prohibit leaving marked paths and disturbing wildlife, and dogs are not allowed [1]. It is best to use a tent for safety and to respect the environment.

st-qa-travel-se-006.text: The Gatwick Express train runs directly from Gatwick Airport to London Victoria, and from there, take the tube to Paddington Station [1]. Luggage can be carried on board the train.

st-qa-travel-se-010.text: It's illegal to alter currency in Italy. Use official coins for parking meters. Avoid altering euro notes.

st-qa-travel-se-012.text: VAT back is possible for electronics purchased from Amazon UK in Ireland, but you must meet the eligibility criteria and follow the proper procedures. The timing of your departure may affect the timing of the VAT refund. Check with the Irish Revenue Office for specific details.

st-qa-travel-se-018.text: Yes, EU roam-like-at-home allows EU citizens to use a local SIM card in Sweden, including a Romanian SIM card, but it may be more expensive than a local prepaid SIM [1]. The SIM card can be used permanently if the EU citizen has a valid SIM card from their home country. [2]

vit-cry-006.text: Quadratic funding is a method used in decentralized finance (DeFi) to allocate funds based on community votes. Its main weakness is that it is vulnerable to collusion, as blockchain transactions are public and can be inspected to determine how individuals "voted" for projects. [3]

vit-cry-007.text: D/acc is a digital-to-analog converter, which converts digital signals to analog signals [1]. It is the opposite of an analog-to-digital converter (ADC). [1]

vit-hum-004.text: Gríma Wormtongue kills Saruman in Isegard during the War of the Ring, as Saruman's army attacks the Shire. Gríma is later shot by hobbit archers after he is killed by Saruman's forces [2].

lan-ref-002.text: The Union won the American Civil War [4]. The Confederacy was defeated, and the war ended with the abolition of slavery [1]. The Union remained united, and the Confederacy was destroyed [4].

lan-cmp-003.text: India is the seventh-largest country in the world by land area [5]. Several countries are larger than India by area, including Russia, Canada, and China.

st-boar-factbook-013.text: Trinidad and Tobago gained independence from the United Kingdom on August 31, 1962 [3]. Its economy has been dominated by the petroleum industry for more than a century.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-020.text: Vaccines generally have mild side effects, and serious side effects are rare [1]. There is no scientific evidence linking vaccines to autism. Vaccinations are safe and effective in preventing serious diseases.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-007.text: In 793, a Viking raid on Lindisfarne scared the monks, and they fled the island [3]. They took with them the body of Saint Cuthbert, which is now buried at Durham Cathedral [3].

lan-exp-003.text: Kenya is in East Africa, near the Horn of Africa, bordered by Tanzania, Uganda, and Somalia [3]. Its capital is Nairobi [3]. Official languages are English and Swahili, and Kenya gained independence in 1963.

st-qa-outdoors-se-008.text: A nor'easter is named because the storm's winds come from the northeast, not the southwest [1]. The name reflects the direction of the wind, not the storm's path.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-007.text: The CDC advises pregnant women not to travel to areas with Zika virus risk, as the virus can be transmitted to the fetus [1]. The risk includes birth defects and neurological problems [3]. Prevention measures are recommended to protect against mosquito bites.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-003.text: Cosmogony focuses on the origin of the universe, while cosmology studies the universe in general [2]. Science cannot describe the first instant of the universe because we lack a theory of quantum gravity to explain the earliest moments of the cosmos [1].

The name "Google" is a play on the word "googol," meaning a number with 100 zeros, and the company earns money by showing advertisements that are targeted to the right audience through its search engine and advertising network.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-005.text: Bitcoin Core is a full node that requires significant resources and cannot earn coins on its own. To earn coins, you need to run a mining pool or use a mining rig. Running Bitcoin Core alone will not generate new coins.

A triangular head is a characteristic feature of some venomous snakes, but it is not a reliable sole indicator of venomosity. Venomosity is determined by other factors such as fang structure, skin texture, and behavior.

st-boar-factbook-010.text: Hong Kong's economy is driven by finance, trade, and services, with the financial sector being a major contributor. The Hong Kong dollar is worth approximately HK$7.80 per US dollar according to the official exchange rate [2].

st-qa-bitcoin-se-015.text: An ASIC miner is a specialized computer chip designed for Bitcoin mining [1]. It beats a regular computer because it is optimized for the specific task of mining, making it much faster and more efficient at solving the complex mathematical problems required for blockchain validation.

st-qa-travel-se-016.text: Get enough sleep before the flight, stay hydrated, and avoid heavy meals. Adjust your schedule to match the local time in Beirut, and consider light exercise to help settle your body.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-013.text: A lightweight SPV wallet verifies payments by checking only the block headers, while a full node validates the entire blockchain [1]. This makes SPV faster and more efficient but less reliable as it trusts full nodes for accuracy.

st-qa-money-se-018.text: Leasing a car offers convenience and flexibility, but buying outright provides ownership and long-term savings. The better choice depends on your priorities and usage.

st-qa-travel-se-015.text: Use a protective case and lens cap to prevent damage. Keep your gear in a secure, weatherproof bag. Avoid leaving lenses exposed to the elements.

Keep your emergency kit, flashlights, and blankets ready. Check weather updates and road conditions before driving.

st-qa-outdoors-se-005.text: No, drinking alcohol does not clean wounds. It can delay healing and cause irritation. Instead, clean the wound with water and apply a disinfectant.
